intent_en: To illustrate the substantial increase in contraceptive usage over time, driven by distribution efforts to remote areas.
previous_intent: To illustrate the significant rise in contraceptive use from 1975 to 2019, driven by the distribution of contraceptives to remote areas.
narration_support: workers brought contraceptives even to the remotest areas, which drove contraceptive use from 8 % in 1975 to 76 % in 2019.
